messages:
kevin: @channel quick heads-up — planning to delay the 1.14.0 ship window by ~4h. CI is hitting an intermittent E2E flake on runner-17 (fails 3/8 matrix runs). I don’t want to push a release with flaky rollback behavior. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samantha: thanks kevin. do we know which test is flaky? short repro?

tia: looks like it’s the session-expiry test hitting a timing issue when the mock auth server is saturated. I can reproduce locally with 10 concurrent sessions.

maria: ok, +1 to delay. can we still cut the branch and hold it as a draft so non-blocking fixes can land?

kevin: plan: 1) cut rc/1.14.0 now, 2) run a focused canary (smaller traffic) after fix, 3) if green, promote. If not, roll back. Can someone take the branch cut?

jen-oncall: I can cut the branch in 10m. will also trigger the canary pipeline once tia’s patch is in.

maria: changelog owners — please add your entries to the PR now. we’ll freeze merges to main after branch cut. I’ll update the release note draft in the GH release.

kevin: commands for the branch cut (copy/paste):

```bash
git checkout -b rc/1.14.0 main
git push origin rc/1.14.0
gh pr create --fill --base main --head rc/1.14.0
```

samantha: leaving a small checklist: @tia reproduce + fix, @jen-oncall cut branch and start canary, @maria update release notes, QA to run quick smoke after canary.

tia: pushing a small timing tweak to session mock now, will open a PR with the e2e tag.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary pipeline queued for rc/1.14.0 — build #4523

jen-oncall: branch cut done: rc/1.14.0 pushed. canary pipeline started (build #4523). tagging reviewers.

maria: updated release notes draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/1.14.0-draft — added changelog bullets and known-issue note about flaky e2e.

kevin: ETA — if fix lands and canary is green within 3h, we ship at the new window (old +4h). if not, we postpone to tomorrow morning and open a hotfix channel. I’ll post an announcement in #announcements once canary status is clear.

samantha: noted. I’ll ping infra for extra runner capacity if canary needs more retries.

tia: PR opened: #789 — includes the timing bump + added retries on mock. requesting review from @sre and @qa.

deploy-bot: [status] canary build #4523: running tests (6/18).

jen-oncall: quick heads-up for release engineers: hold version bump in package.json until after canary green — we’ll bump on the merge of rc branch to main and tag.

maria: also pinging docs to hold off publishing the upgrade guide until the final version tag.

kevin: thanks all. action items summarized:
- tia: get PR in and deploy to canary
- jen-oncall: cut branch (done) + monitor canary
- sam: coordinate infra if we need runner capacity
- maria: update release notes + hold docs
- qa: smoke after canary

I’ll update this thread when canary finishes. :white_check_mark: 

deploy-bot: [status] canary build #4523: tests passed (18/18) — canary healthy.

jen-oncall: canary green. promoting RC -> main in 20m if no blockers.

samantha: merging changelog PRs now.

maria: publishing release notes at ship time.

kevin: final call — proceeding with ship in 20m. I’ll post to #announcements once it’s live. thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :rocket:
